lead: The plan hands PPC ten recurring reads and checks. Four already have results; the light-push cost read lands on Nov 2.

tasks.task: Daily launch read: day 3, top-of-search clicks at least 80% of goal; day 7, conversion against the market
tasks.status: Reported daily on the daily recommendation board. Per-keyword click goals are not on the boards, so day 3 cannot be scored yet. On cooling sheets queen, 1 of 12 head-exact clicks came from top of search (13–20 Oct).
tasks.next: Joseph shares the click goal per push keyword. Day-7 read for the Oct 19 pushes on Oct 26.

tasks.task: Light-push cost calibration: spend per rank gained by size (CL-PU8)
tasks.status: Running. King group 16–19 Oct: $437.34, 111 clicks, 13 orders; cooling sheets king size moved #38 → #3 → #7. Queen group: $114.47, 40 clicks, 1 order; cooling sheets queen #76 → #68.
tasks.next: Read on 7-day median ranks on Nov 2, by size.

tasks.task: Step 2: top-of-search price stepped up daily toward the ceilings (King $9.02, Queen $8.45, Full $7.20, Twin $6.72)
tasks.status: Oct 19 delivered $434.59 against the ~$980 estimate; budgets of $1,913 were 23% used.
tasks.next: Read Oct 20–21 delivered spend before the next step (A1).

tasks.task: Push searches as negative exacts in broad, phrase and auto
tasks.status: Consistent with the data: Auto took 4 clicks on 16–19 Oct, all on unrelated searches. No push keyword leaked into Auto. Our own campaigns overlapped on 6 of 89 search terms.
tasks.next: Add cooling sheets queen as a negative exact in Queen Tail 18 the day the head moves to ranking.

tasks.task: "fitted" as a negative phrase on rank campaigns (F1 · C-K7)
tasks.status: $0 on fitted searches since launch; no fitted search terms on 16–19 Oct. We have not yet verified that the negative phrase is written.
tasks.next: PPC checks the negatives in the next bulk export.

tasks.task: Entry gate (85% in stock by colour over the push and two weeks after) and spare test, the week before each push
tasks.status: Cal King (Oct 26) fails: spare 2 units. The head push (Nov 30) is read the week of Nov 23.
tasks.next: Recommend CL-PC3 option B for Cal King (A4).

tasks.task: Coverage-registry read: top-of-search CPC, share and clicks on shared against unshared searches (CL-PU5 / CL-PC2)
tasks.status: First read, cooling sheets queen, 13–20 Oct: Sleephoria 20 clicks for $39.44 ($1.97 CPC); CooLinens 16 clicks for $36.60 ($2.29 CPC).
tasks.next: Weekly read from Oct 27, shared against unshared goal searches.

tasks.task: Live tests read once at two weeks, stop-loss at 2× break-even (CL-PC5)
tasks.status: Two-week mark is Oct 30 – Nov 1. Rival pages so far: 30 clicks, 0 orders, $66.00. Stop-loss line: 2 × 39.1% = 78.2% ACoS.
tasks.next: Two-week read on the daily board; relevance negatives on the rival pages now (A7).

tasks.task: Lanes stepped by hand each morning until Target Setting holds 69 (CL-PC6)
tasks.status: Target Setting holds nothing for 69, so the morning steps stay manual.

tasks.task: Cal King rank exacts through the Change Loader as a new slate
tasks.status: Not built; 0 of 6 Cal King push keywords on a rank exact.
tasks.next: Build ready; switch on after the bridge if option B is chosen.

qa.a: For King, early yes: King units rose from 4.3 to 9.25 a day and several King searches reached the top 10 within four days. But 9 of King's 13 SP orders came on Oct 18; without that day King's ACoS is 78.2%. For Queen, not yet: its head is held on profit bids and 8 of its 40 push keywords have no campaign.

qa.q: How much are we spending against the plan?
qa.a: $1,158.30 over 16–19 Oct, about $290 a day, against the plan's October $1,293 a day. The step-2 day (Oct 19) spent $434.59.

qa.q: Why is spend below the ~$980 step-2 estimate?
qa.a: Budgets were 23% used on Oct 19, so budget is not the limit. Our reading is that bids and placement eligibility cap delivery. We will confirm this with Oct 20–21 data before any change.

For a launch under the honeymoon rule, yes. The plan's own split shows the conversion exacts at 34.7% (under the 39.1% line) and the rank-labelled exacts at 60.0% as rank investment (TCC_PPC_Today, Oct 13–19).

qa.q: Should King get a bigger share of the push?
qa.a: Not yet. Re-decide on the Nov 2 calibration with a full fortnight of data (P1).

qa.q: Should Queen's head move to ranking now?
qa.a: The rule says wait for the order date, and we agree. On that day, we ask that Queen's head moves first (K2).

qa.q: Do we have the stock to push?
qa.a: At the live pace, yes for every size: King's 1,103 units last about 119 days. Cal King fails the plan's own spare-unit test for its push (2 spare units). At the plan's pace King runs out about Dec 14, before the bridge (P3, E2).

qa.q: Are our campaigns competing with each other, or with Sleephoria?
qa.a: Internally, little: 6 of 89 search terms were bought by two of our campaigns. With Sleephoria, yes, on cooling sheets queen: its two Queen ranking exacts bid +145% and +160% top of search (P4).

Relevance only, not performance: unrelated searches on the rival-page campaigns (silk, tencel, comforters, cooling blanket); the sister brand (sleephoria cooling sheets took 1 click on Cooling Rivals Queen). The brand search coolinens was served only by pillowcase campaigns, with no cooling-sheet branded exact.

qa.q: When can PPC give a number for the December push budget?
qa.a: On Nov 2: spend per rank gained by size, on 7-day median ranks.

qa.q: What does PPC need from Joseph?
qa.a: The click goal per push keyword (for the day-3 read), who confirms the order date (A2), and decisions on F1, K2, P5, A4 and the colour switches (P6, P7).
